name: Artifact Share
description: Takes an output your AI has just produced and publishes it at an address a client can open in a browser, rather than a chat transcript. Runs on Bauta and keeps things private unless you say otherwise, so it suits work you hand to people outside your tools.

official.title: Artifact Share by Henry
official.description: Turns what your AI just made into a real URL a client can open. For Grok Bot users who are done sending chat links. Uses Bauta. Private by default.
